models.name: todo_users
models.description:
User account profiles with email authentication and profile information for the todo application.

Stores verified user details including email, password hash for secure authentication, and optional profile display name. Each user account is uniquely identified and requires email verification before full access.

Email verification status is tracked to prevent unauthorized access. User accounts support soft deletion through the deleted_at field while preserving historical user data. The user's display name can be optionally set but is only visible to the user themselves.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address for login and verification, must be unique across all users.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Secure hash of user's password for authentication, never stored as plaintext.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Optional public display name visible only to the user themselves.

plainFields.name: email_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates if the user has completed email verification process.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when user account details were last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when user account was soft deleted. Null indicates active account.

models.name: todo_user_sessions
models.description:
JWT session tokens for user authentication with access and refresh tokens, 15-minute expiration.

Stores connection metadata for user login sessions including IP address, connection URL, and referrer URL. Each session is tied to a specific user account and expires after 15 minutes for security.

Uses append-only audit trail pattern with created_at and expired_at timestamps. Follows strict authorization session management standards for the todo application.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address used to establish the connection.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Original connection URL used during session establishment.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Source URL that referred the user to this connection.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expires after 15 minutes.

models.name: todo_user_password_resets
models.description:
Stores password reset tokens for users with expiration times to securely reset user account passwords.

Each token is uniquely associated with a user account and automatically expires after a predefined period. Tokens are generated during password recovery workflows and require verification before resetting credentials. The table supports soft deletion to manage expired or canceled tokens without data loss.

This table is managed through the user account entity and requires no independent API endpoints.

Relationship summary:
- One user can have multiple password reset tokens (1:N)
- Tokens reference user account for validation context

foreignFields.name: todo_user_id
foreignFields.description: User's ID this password reset is for. {@link todo_users.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique token string generated for password reset process. Must be long and cryptographically secure for security.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp of the password reset token. After this time, the token becomes invalid for password resets.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the password reset token was generated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was deleted (soft delete). If non-null, token is considered expired or canceled.

models.name: todo_user_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens used during user registration to confirm new account activation.

Stores tokens generated when users sign up for the application, requiring email verification before account activation. Each token includes an expiration to prevent abuse and ensure timely verification.

Tokens are tied to specific user accounts and emails, with expiration automatically triggering token invalidation after a set period. The system does not store personal identity data beyond the email address associated with the token.

Soft deletion is supported to maintain audit trails while allowing token cleanup, with records kept for historical analysis of verification attempts.

foreignFields.name: todo_user_id
foreignFields.description: User account associated with this verification request. {@link todo_users.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token string. Must be cryptographically secure and unique across all tokens.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address being verified. Must match the email used during registration.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. MUST NOT NULL as tokens must expire for security.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when token was generated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last token update (should match creation if token doesn't change).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when token was soft-deleted (NULL for active tokens).

models.name: todo_todos
models.description:
Main table for storing all user todo items with required title, optional description, start and due dates, and completion status.

Each todo item belongs to a single user and is initially created with incomplete status by default. The table supports soft deletion to allow trashing items without permanent removal.

Todos can be searched across all items regardless of parent context, supporting independent user management and API operations.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the todo item. Required for creation, cannot be blank.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional description of the todo item. Can be left empty or empty string.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Optional start date for the todo item. Can be left empty if not applicable.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date for the todo item. Can be left empty if not applicable.

plainFields.name: completed
plainFields.description: Completion status of the todo item. New items are created with false (incomplete) by default.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the todo item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the todo item was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the todo item was marked for deletion (soft delete).

models.name: todo_histories
models.description:
Tracks all edit history entries for todos including previous and new values for title, description, and date fields.

The history records are automatically created whenever a todo item is modified, capturing the previous and new values for all editable fields. History entries are stored permanently until the associated todo item is permanently deleted. Note that history entries are managed automatically and users cannot directly interact with or modify history records.

foreignFields.name: todo_todo_id
foreignFields.description: The main todo item that was edited. {@link todo_todos.id}

plainFields.name: previous_title
plainFields.description: Title value before the edit. Set to null if this was the first title set.

plainFields.name: new_title
plainFields.description: Title value after the edit.

plainFields.name: previous_description
plainFields.description: Description value before the edit. Set to null if this was the first description set.

plainFields.name: new_description
plainFields.description: Description value after the edit.

plainFields.name: previous_start_date
plainFields.description: Previous start date before the edit. Null if this was the first start date.

plainFields.name: new_start_date
plainFields.description: New start date after the edit.

plainFields.name: previous_due_date
plainFields.description: Previous due date before the edit. Null if this was the first due date.

plainFields.name: new_due_date
plainFields.description: New due date after the edit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the history entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when the history entry was last updated. This field is typically the same as created_at for history entries.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Optional timestamp for soft deletion. History entries are only soft-deleted when the parent todo is permanently deleted.
